truth_table.strengthened_above_oracle: current conservatively exceeds the oracle floor
truth_table.strengthened_below_oracle: current raises its native floor but is below the original oracle
truth_table.strengthened_meets_oracle: current raises its native floor to the original oracle floor
truth_table.unchanged_below_oracle: current equals its native floor but is below the original oracle
truth_table.unchanged_meets_oracle: current equals its native floor and meets the original oracle floor
